subject.title: Proactive messages not visible in session context, causing conversation desynchronization

question: Should successful proactive deliveries use one destination-session awareness contract across command cron, isolated cron, and heartbeat paths, and which state should be durable versus next-turn-only?
rationale: The current report identifies a concrete command-cron gap, but the umbrella request spans several delivery origins with different replay and concurrency semantics; choosing a uniform persistence policy is product and architecture direction rather than a mechanical one-file repair.

options.title: Adopt a shared destination-session contract
options.body: Define a common success-only session-aware delivery seam and implement command cron as the first missing caller, preserving per-origin durable versus ephemeral semantics.

options.title: Split command cron into a narrow bug
options.body: Create or sponsor a scoped command-cron fix while retaining this issue as the cross-origin contract discussion.

options.title: Keep origin-specific behavior
options.body: Document that only selected proactive paths receive destination-session awareness and decline a general consistency guarantee.

recommendation.title: Adopt a shared destination-session contract
recommendation.body: Define a common success-only session-aware delivery seam and implement command cron as the first missing caller, preserving per-origin durable versus ephemeral semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent target-session awareness work is the closest merged implementation boundary for deciding how the missing command-cron caller should participate.
